en.text:
Efficacy:
1. Balance hormones, relax the body and mind, relieve tension, enhance female libido, relieve anxiety and negative emotions caused by depression
2. Enhance immunity, resist toxicity, and prevent discomfort caused by influenza or respiratory diseases
3. Very effective for dry and dehydrated skin, making the skin soft and elastic, improving fine lines, making it tender and bright
Usage Instructions:
1. Air Freshener：
Can be used both day and night. Spray around the pillow, on bedding, or inside closets to freshen the air and refresh the mind
2. Toner / Facial Lotion：
Apply directly by patting onto the skin to boost hydration. Helps brighten, moisturize, and nourish the skin — an essential product for women’s skincare.
3. Face Mask Application：
Soak a mask sheet thoroughly and apply to the face for 15–20 minutes
Note：Do not wait until the mask is completely dry before removing, as this can draw moisture and nutrients back into the mask and air. This method helps soothe, hydrate, and brighten the skin

structured_data.description: 功效：1. 幫助放鬆，充滿正能量2. 紓緩⽉經周期及更年期不適3. 鎮痛，舒解壓⼒4. 平靜⼤腦，驅蚊除蟲5. 消除疲勞，增添積極能量使用方法 ：1.香薰燈：200尺區域可用5滴精油，按房間實際增加或減少精油的用量2.按摩：基底油10ml：5滴精油調和後進行按摩或塗抹肌膚，面部基底油5ml：2滴精油3.將1滴精油滴在紙巾或滴2滴在擴香木上，放在離自己較近的地方，有助於放鬆改善良好情緒4.泡浴減壓：使用50ml全脂牛奶, 8-10滴精油調和後，直接倒在熱水裡然後泡浴

en.text:
Efficacy:
1. Helps relax and is full of positive energy
2. Relieves menstrual cycle and menopausal discomfort
3. Analgesics, relieves stress
4. Calms the brain, repels mosquitoes and insects
5. Eliminates fatigue and adds positive energy
Usage Instructions:
1. Aromatherapy Diffuser：
Use 5 drops of essential oil for an area of 200 square feet. Adjust the amount according to the actual size of the room
2. Massage：
- Body：Mix 5 drops of essential oil with 10 ml of carrier oil, then use for massage or skin application
- Face：Mix 2 drops of essential oil with 5 ml of carrier oil for facial use
3. Direct Inhalation:
Place 1 drop of essential oil on a tissue or 2 drops on a diffuser wood pad, and position it close to you. This helps promote relaxation and improve mood
4. Bath for Stress Relief:
Mix 50 ml of full-fat milk with 8–10 drops of essential oil, then pour into hot bathwater and soak

1. Extremely soothing effect, restoring a sense of joy and tranquility
2. Helping to manage emotions and fight stress, especially anxiety problems caused by new mothers or shocks

5. Quickly hydrate, eliminate uneven skin tone and dullness
Usage Instructions:
1. Oral Consumption:
For healthy individuals, add 1 bottle cap to 1000 ml of water
For individuals with poor concentration, add 6 bottle caps to 1000 ml of water
Consume within one day
2.Spray（Hydration Boost）：
Reapply when the skin feels dry after absorption. Repeat spraying 10 times to rapidly increase skin moisture levels. Afterwards, spray every 3 hours — especially effective for oily and combination skin types

Soak a mask sheet thoroughly and apply to the face for 15–20 minutes
Note:Do not wait until the mask is completely dry before removing it, as this may cause moisture and nutrients to be drawn back into the mask and the air
4. Intimate Area Cleansing:
Use10–30 ml directly for cleansing the intimate area

en.text:
Efficacy:
1. Relieve stress and tension, increase energy
2. Help people with anxiety, depression and accumulated chronic stress
3. Balance hormones and improve related emotional problems caused by hormonal imbalance
4. Regulate the venous system, promote internal and external body circulation, eliminate swollen neck glands
5. Toner for normal or mixed skin, powerful antioxidant, very effective in fighting aging
Usage Instructions:
1. Face Mask Application:
Soak a mask sheet thoroughly and apply to the face for 15–20 minutes.
Note: Do not wait until the mask is completely dry before removing it, as this may cause moisture and nutrients to be drawn back into the mask and the air.
2. For Oily, Combination, or Enlarged Pores Skin:
After cleansing, spray directly onto the skin and gently pat to absorb. Repeat 2–3 times.

Spray directly onto areas such as varicose veins, swelling, or joints to help improve microcirculation.
4. Mood Support via Aromatherapy:
Spray directly into the air around you to help ease anxiety and uplift mood.

structured_data.description: Efficacy: This product is specifically formulated for treating facial acne, excess toxins, enlarged pores, and blackheadsUsage instructions:Salon / Professional use: It is recommended to first use Carotene to remove dead skin, then begin the treatment kit.No. 1 Balancing Cream – Apply the entire amount to the face using a brush. en.html:
Efficacy: This product is specifically formulated for treating facial acne, excess toxins, enlarged pores, and blackheads

Usage instructions:

Salon / Professional use: It is recommended to first use Carotene to remove dead skin, then begin the treatment kit.

  1. No. 1 Balancing Cream – Apply the entire amount to the face using a brush. Leave on for five minutes, then gently pat the remaining amount into the skin until fully absorbed.

  2. Comedone extraction (needle cleaning) for acne and blackheads – to be performed at the therapist's discretion.

  3. Apply a few drops of TOP LINE onto acne and comedone areas. Wait three minutes.

  4. No. 2 Treatment Serum – Apply to the entire face and neck. Leave on for five minutes without wiping off, allowing it to absorb. For better results, use in combination with YOUNG AGAIN blue light therapy.

  5. No. 3 Repairing Mask – Apply the entire amount evenly over the entire treated area. Leave on for 15–20 minutes, then wipe off.

  6. Finally, apply a thin layer of DNA Balancing Sensitive Cream.

Note: A minimum of 8 treatments is recommended, once every 5 days. For every 4 PUFAC treatments, incorporate one additional hydrating repair / skin regeneration treatment. In the morning, use DNA Balancing Sensitive Cream or sunscreen (avoid unprotected exposure to UV rays).

en.text:

Soak a mask sheet thoroughly and apply to the face for 15–20 minutes.

Add 1 bottle cap to 1000ml of water.

Reapply whenever the skin feels dry after absorption. Repeat spraying 10 times to significantly increase skin hydration in a short period. Follow up with a spray every 3 hours for anti-allergy and brightening effects.

Spray onto hair to smooth and soften strands while protecting against UV damage.
5. Eye Compress:
Soak cotton pads or eye mask sheets and place them over the eyes for 10–15 minutes.
6. Intimate Area Cleansing:
Use 10–30ml directly for cleansing the intimate area.

Spray onto hair to smooth and soften strands while protecting against UV damage.

5. Eye Compress:

Soak cotton pads or eye mask sheets and place them over the eyes for 10–15 minutes.

6. Intimate Area Cleansing: 

Use 10–30ml directly for cleansing the intimate area.

en.text:
Efficacy:
1. Improve indigestion and relieve nervous physiological conditions
2. Reduce blood pressure and slow down abnormal heartbeat
3. Keep skin moist and restore smoothness and delicateness
4. Reduce skin infection or acne
5. Relax the mind and enhance health
Usage Instructions:
1. Aromatherapy Diffuser:
Use 5 drops of essential oil for an area of 200 square feet. Adjust the amount of essential oil according to the actual size of the room
2. Massage:
For relaxation and boosting immunity, blend 5 drops of essential oil with 10 ml of carrier oil. Use the mixture for a full-body massage or apply it to the skin
3. Direct Inhalation:
Place 1 drop of essential oil on a tissue or 2 drops on a diffuser wood pad, and position it close to you or beside your pillow
4. Bathing for Stress Relief:
Mix 50 ml of full-fat milk with 8–10 drops of essential oil, then pour the mixture into hot bathwater for a soothing soak
en.html:
Efficacy: 

1. Improve indigestion and relieve nervous physiological conditions 

2. Reduce blood pressure and slow down abnormal heartbeat

3. Keep skin moist and restore smoothness and delicateness 

4. Reduce skin infection or acne 

5. Relax the mind and enhance health


Usage Instructions:

1. Aromatherapy Diffuser:

Use 5 drops of essential oil for an area of 200 square feet. Adjust the amount of essential oil according to the actual size of the room

2. Massage:

For relaxation and boosting immunity, blend 5 drops of essential oil with 10 ml of carrier oil. Use the mixture for a full-body massage or apply it to the skin

3. Direct Inhalation:

Place 1 drop of essential oil on a tissue or 2 drops on a diffuser wood pad, and position it close to you or beside your pillow

4. Bathing for Stress Relief:

Mix 50 ml of full-fat milk with 8–10 drops of essential oil, then pour the mixture into hot bathwater for a soothing soak

structured_data.description: 功效：1.  具有鎮靜大腦神經和幫助身心靈放鬆，改善睡眠2.  紓緩身體痛症，長時間工作和劇烈運動後引起的肌肉不適能得以紓緩3.  增強記憶力、止咳祛痰、紓緩紅疹、紅斑痤瘡、粉刺和痱子，減淡黑眼圈使用方法 :1.噴霧(補充水分)：待皮膚吸收後感覺乾燥時再噴，反復噴霧10次，皮膚含水量會在短時間內提高，之後每3小時做一次噴霧2.口服：適合任何人士; 1瓶蓋加1000ml水, 睡眠質素差的人士6瓶蓋加1000ml水，一天內飮用完3.敷面: 把面膜紙浸濕，敷15- 20分鐘，注意：不要等面膜紙完全乾後取下，這樣水份及營養會被倒吸到面膜和空氣中，有補水抗衰老作用4.敷眼：浸濕棉花或眼膜紙敷眼10- 15分鐘5.清潔私密部位：使用10 - 30ml直接清洗

en.text:
Efficacy:
1. It calms the brain nerves and helps relax the body and mind, improving sleep.
2. Relieves physical pain and muscle discomfort caused by long-term work and strenuous exercise.
3. Enhances memory, relieves coughs and eliminates phlegm. Relieve rashes, rosacea, acne and prickly heat, and reduce dark circles
Usage Instructions:
1. Spray（Hydration Boost）：
Reapply when the skin feels dry after absorption. Repeat spraying 10 times to rapidly increase skin moisture. Afterwards, spray every 3 hours to maintain hydration.
2. Oral Consumption：
Suitable for everyone. For general use, add 1 bottle cap to 1000 ml of water. For individuals with poor sleep quality, add 6 bottle caps to 1000 ml of water. Consume within one day.
3. Face Mask Application:
Soak a mask sheet thoroughly and apply to the face for 15–20 minutes.
Note： Do not wait until the mask is completely dry before removing it, as this may cause moisture and nutrients to be drawn back into the mask and the air. This method helps hydrate and combat signs of aging.
4. Eye Compress:
Soak cotton pads or eye mask sheets and place them over the eyes for 10–15 minutes.
5. Intimate Area Cleansing：
Use 10–30 ml directly for cleansing the intimate area.

en.text:
Efficacy: 1. Promote quality sleep 2. Relax and relieve muscle tension 3. Promote digestion 4. Improve heart health
Usage Instructions:
1. Aromatherapy Diffuser：
Use 5 drops of essential oil for an area of 200 square feet. Adjust the amount of essential oil according to the actual size of the room
2. Massage：
Mix 5 drops of essential oil with 10 ml of carrier oil, then apply all over the body for a soothing massage
3. Direct Inhalation for Sleep Support：

structured_data.description: 功效：1.清除空氣中的細菌黴味、對抗真菌及微⽣物; 治療感冒和⽀氣管充⾎2.減輕⽛⾁腫痛3.紓緩緊張不安情緒4.增強免疫⼒及淨化室內環境使用方法 ：1.香薰燈：200尺區域使用5滴精油，按房間實際增加或減少精油的用量2.將1滴精油滴在紙巾或滴2滴在擴香木上，放在枕頭或身體較近的地方3.衣櫃、儲物櫃、鞋櫃除味可使用3-5滴精油在棉花球上，放置角落，去除味道同時有清香味

en.text:
Efficacy:
1. Remove bacteria and musty smell in the air, fight fungi and microorganisms, treat colds and tracheal congestion
2. Eliminate swelling and pain
3. Relieve tension and anxiety
4. Enhance immunity and purify indoor environment
Usage Instructions:
1.Aromatherapy Diffuser: Use 5 drops of essential oil for a 200-square-foot area. Adjust the amount of oil based on the actual size of the room
2.Place 1 drop of essential oil on a tissue or 2 drops on a diffuser wood pad, and position it near your pillow or close to your body
3.For wardrobes, storage cabinets, or shoe cabinets to eliminate odors, apply 3–5 drops of essential oil on a cotton ball and place it in a corner. This will help remove unpleasant smells while leaving a fresh fragrance

en.text:
Efficacy:
1. Reduce headaches and relieve discomfort caused by inflammation
2. After dilution, make a mouthwash to eliminate bacteria in the mouth and remove odor
3. Drinking it can promote absorption in the digestive system
4. External application can relieve muscle sprains and help wound healing
Usage Instructions:
1.Natural Toner or Direct Application:Use as a natural toner by applying directly, or saturate a face mask sheet or cotton pad and place it on the face or eye area. Applying as a wet compress on bruises or contusions can help reduce swelling and disperse bruising.
2.Oral Use:Suitable for all individuals. Add the equivalent of 1 bottle cap of floral water to 1000ml of water. For those with weaker digestive systems, the dosage can be increased to 6 bottle caps, and the mixture should be consumed within one day.
3.Mouthwash: Helps improve gum health and prevent gum recession.
en.html:
Efficacy: 

1. Reduce headaches and relieve discomfort caused by inflammation 

2. After dilution, make a mouthwash to eliminate bacteria in the mouth and remove odor 

3. Drinking it can promote absorption in the digestive system

4. External application can relieve muscle sprains and help wound healing


Usage Instructions:


1.Natural Toner or Direct Application:Use as a natural toner by applying directly, or saturate a face mask sheet or cotton pad and place it on the face or eye area. Applying as a wet compress on bruises or contusions can help reduce swelling and disperse bruising.  

2.Oral Use:Suitable for all individuals. Add the equivalent of 1 bottle cap of floral water to 1000ml of water. For those with weaker digestive systems, the dosage can be increased to 6 bottle caps, and the mixture should be consumed within one day.  

3.Mouthwash: Helps improve gum health and prevent gum recession.

structured_data.name: 能量煥發香薰油配方一
structured_data.description: 功效：1.抗菌，增強免疫⼒2.消除痤瘡，緩解鼻竇炎3.消除細菌4.改善痛⾵和改善宿醉5.平衡油脂分泌使用方法 ：1.香薰燈：200尺區域可用5滴精油，按房間實際增加或減少精油的用量2.按摩：放鬆增強抵抗力, 使用基底油10ml：5滴精油調和後進行全身按摩或塗抹肌膚3.將1滴精油滴在紙巾或滴2滴在擴香木上，放在離自己較近或枕頭旁邊4.泡浴減壓：使用50ml全脂牛奶, 8-10滴精油調和後，直接倒在熱水裡泡浴

en.text:
Efficacy:
1. Antibacterial, enhance immunity
2. Eliminate acne, relieve sinusitis
3. Eliminate bacteria, improve inhalation problems
4. Clear Gout pain, relieve hangover
5. Balance oil secretion
Usage Instructions:
1. Aromatherapy Diffuser:
Use 5 drops of essential oil for an area of 200 square feet. Adjust the amount of essential oil according to the actual size of the room
2. Massage:
For relaxation and boosting immunity, blend 5 drops of essential oil with 10 ml of carrier oil. Use the mixture for a full-body massage or apply it to the skin
3. Direct Inhalation:
Place 1 drop of essential oil on a tissue or 2 drops on a diffuser wood pad, and position it close to you or beside your pillow
4. Bathing for Stress Relief:
Mix 50 ml of full-fat milk with 8–10 drops of essential oil, then pour the mixture into hot bathwater for a soothing soak

en.text:
Efficacy:
1. Anti-bacteria that cause respiratory infections, reduce nasal inflammation and nasal congestion leading to swelling and pain
2. Clear nasal congestion, relieve respiratory discomfort caused by sinusitis, nasal allergies, and colds, restore smooth flow and discharge nasal mucus
3. Promote the healing of acne or wounds, avoid leaving scars on wounds
4. Improve body itching; prevent mosquito bites; reduce inflammation and reduce redness and swelling
Usage Instructions:
1. As a Natural Toner/Facial Lotion：
Apply directly by patting onto the skin to increase hydration. Alternatively, soak a mask sheet or cotton pad with 10–15 ml and leave on for 15–20 minutes. For acne-prone skin, blend with chamomile floral water to soothe, hydrate, reduce inflammation, and minimize pores
2. Intimate Area Cleansing：
Use 10–30 ml directly for cleansing the intimate area.
3. Nasal Rinse：
Apply 3–5 drops inside the nostrils to help reduce inflammation and clear nasal mucus.
4. Oral Consumption:
Suitable for everyone. For general use, add 1 bottle cap to 1000 ml of water. For individuals with nasal sensitivity, add 6 bottle caps to 1000 ml of water. Consume within one day
5. Spray (Hydration Boost)：
Reapply when the skin feels dry after absorption. Repeat spraying 10 times to rapidly increase skin moisture. Then, spray every 3 hours — especially effective for oily and combination skin types

This product is for wholesale members only. After purchasing this membership, the system will automatically issue the corresponding shopping credit and upgrade to the specified membership level upon confirmation of payment to enjoy wholesale discounts.

en.text:
Efficacy:
1. Antibacterial, antifungal, antifungal, antimicrobial
2. Reduce colds caused by bacterial infections
3. Enhance immunity
4. Improve air quality and maintain indoor humidity
5. Relieve tension and relax mood
Usage Instructions:
1.Aromatherapy Diffuser: Use 5 drops of essential oil for a 200-square-foot area. Adjust the amount of oil based on the actual size of the room
2.Place 1 drop of essential oil on a tissue or 2 drops on a diffuser wood pad, and position it near your pillow or close to your body
3.For wardrobes, storage cabinets, or shoe cabinets to eliminate odors, apply 3–5 drops of essential oil on a cotton ball and place it in a corner. This will help remove unpleasant smells while leaving a fresh fragrance

structured_data.name: Delight 3 Pro專業套裝
structured_data.description: 功效：抗色素異常 , 美白提亮 , 抗衰老療程,  改善膚色暗沉及蠟黃, 保濕 ,祛斑 使用方法：（美容院療程）清潔+爽膚 :使用超溫和清潔霜清潔並徹底沖洗。煥膚階段(去除死細胞):對於敏感肌膚,技師可根據情況每次避免去角質或縮短使用時間,輕拍幾滴修顏精華液。用扇形刷薄薄塗抹3-5ml的Delight 3PRO第一步煥膚產品,停留5分鐘。必要時,在沖洗前用指尖輕輕按摩重點區域。清潔/沖洗 :徹底沖洗。平衡參數(pH值+天然保濕因子)輕拍塗抹一層薄的特殊消失霜恢復pH值,然後用紗布輕拍特殊保濕復合物恢復天然保濕因子。註:前4次護理必須執行此步驟,之後可由操作師酌情選擇。 僅在色斑處塗抹0.5ml Delight擊退黑斑精華,直到吸收。控制黑色素形成階段 : 用輕刷動作在全臉塗抹5ml Delight 3PRO第二步啫哩激活劑,停留5分鐘。昇華階段 : 用刷子塗抹10ml Delight 3PRO第三步驟護理面膜,停留7-10分鐘,期間可進行指壓按摩。時間到後,透過抗老按摩讓剩餘面膜吸收。 最後用微濕棉片輕拍去除殘留物。結束護理:最後塗抹一層多效防護霜抵禦外界環境。護理週期 :建議至少先進行4-5次護理(為一個療程),每週1次。其後每15天進行1次護理(4次為一個療程) 。最後每月進行1次維護護理。注意:針對色斑問題,必須使用完整的美容護理流程。

en.text:
Efficacy: Anti-pigmentation treatment, whitening and brightening, anti-aging treatment, improves dull and sallow skin tone, moisturizes, and removes blemishes
Usage Instructions: (Salon / Professional Treatment)
Cleansing + Toning: Cleanse with an ultra-gentle cleansing cream and rinse thoroughly.
Exfoliation Phase (Removal of Dead Cells): For sensitive skin, the therapist may skip exfoliation or shorten the application time as appropriate. Gently pat a few drops of Skin Refining Serum.
Apply a thin layer (3-5ml) of Delight 3PRO Step 1 Exfoliating Product using a fan brush. Leave on for 5 minutes. If necessary, gently massage targeted areas with fingertips before rinsing.
Cleanse / Rinse: Rinse thoroughly.
Balancing Parameters (pH + Natural Moisturizing Factors):
Apply a thin layer of Special Vanishing Cream to restore pH levels using a gentle patting motion. Then, use gauze to gently pat on the Special Moisturizing Complex to restore Natural Moisturizing Factors (NMF)
Note: This step must be performed for the first 4 treatments. Thereafter, it may be performed at the therapist's discretion. Apply 0.5ml of Delight Dark Spot Corrector only on pigmented areas until absorbed.
Melanin Control Phase: Apply 5ml of Delight 3PRO Step 2 Gel Activator over the entire face using light brushing motions. Leave on for 5 minutes.
Boosting Phase: Apply 10ml of Delight 3PRO Step 3 Treatment Mask using a brush. Leave on for 7–10 minutes, during which finger pressure massage may be performed. After the time has elapsed, allow the remaining mask to be absorbed through anti-aging massage. Finally, gently pat off any residue with a slightly damp cotton pad.
Final Step: Apply a layer of Multi-Protection Cream to defend against environmental aggressors.
Treatment Cycle:
It is recommended to first undergo at least 4–5 treatments (as one course), once per week.
Thereafter, have 1 treatment every 15 days (4 treatments per course).
Finally, have 1 maintenance treatment per month.
Note: For pigmentation issues, the complete professional treatment protocol must be followed.
en.html:
Efficacy: Anti-pigmentation treatment, whitening and brightening, anti-aging treatment, improves dull and sallow skin tone, moisturizes, and removes blemishes


Usage Instructions: (Salon / Professional Treatment)

Cleansing + Toning: Cleanse with an ultra-gentle cleansing cream and rinse thoroughly.

Exfoliation Phase (Removal of Dead Cells): For sensitive skin, the therapist may skip exfoliation or shorten the application time as appropriate. Gently pat a few drops of Skin Refining Serum.

Apply a thin layer (3-5ml) of Delight 3PRO Step 1 Exfoliating Product using a fan brush. Leave on for 5 minutes. If necessary, gently massage targeted areas with fingertips before rinsing.

Cleanse / Rinse: Rinse thoroughly.

Balancing Parameters (pH + Natural Moisturizing Factors):
Apply a thin layer of Special Vanishing Cream to restore pH levels using a gentle patting motion. Then, use gauze to gently pat on the Special Moisturizing Complex to restore Natural Moisturizing Factors (NMF)

Note: This step must be performed for the first 4 treatments. Thereafter, it may be performed at the therapist's discretion. Apply 0.5ml of Delight Dark Spot Corrector only on pigmented areas until absorbed.

Melanin Control Phase: Apply 5ml of Delight 3PRO Step 2 Gel Activator over the entire face using light brushing motions. Leave on for 5 minutes.

Boosting Phase: Apply 10ml of Delight 3PRO Step 3 Treatment Mask using a brush. Leave on for 7–10 minutes, during which finger pressure massage may be performed. After the time has elapsed, allow the remaining mask to be absorbed through anti-aging massage. Finally, gently pat off any residue with a slightly damp cotton pad.

Final Step: Apply a layer of Multi-Protection Cream to defend against environmental aggressors.

Treatment Cycle:

  • It is recommended to first undergo at least 4–5 treatments (as one course), once per week.

  • Thereafter, have 1 treatment every 15 days (4 treatments per course).

  • Finally, have 1 maintenance treatment per month.

Note: For pigmentation issues, the complete professional treatment protocol must be followed.

zh-hant.text:
功效：抗色素異常 , 美白提亮 , 抗衰老療程, 改善膚色暗沉及蠟黃, 保濕 ,祛斑
使用方法：（美容院療程）
清潔+爽膚 :使用超溫和清潔霜清潔並徹底沖洗。
煥膚階段(去除死細胞):對於敏感肌膚,技師可根據情況每次避免去角質或縮短使用時間,輕拍幾滴修顏精華液。
用扇形刷薄薄塗抹3-5ml的Delight 3PRO第一步煥膚產品,停留5分鐘。必要時,在沖洗前用指尖輕輕按摩重點區域。
清潔/沖洗 :徹底沖洗。
平衡參數(pH值+天然保濕因子)
輕拍塗抹一層薄的特殊消失霜恢復pH值,然後用紗布輕拍特殊保濕復合物恢復天然保濕因子。
註:前4次護理必須執行此步驟,之後可由操作師酌情選擇。 僅在色斑處塗抹0.5ml Delight擊退黑斑精華,直到吸收。
控制黑色素形成階段 : 用輕刷動作在全臉塗抹5ml Delight 3PRO第二步啫哩激活劑,停留5分鐘。
昇華階段 : 用刷子塗抹10ml Delight 3PRO第三步驟護理面膜,停留7-10分鐘,期間可進行指壓按摩。時間到後,透過抗老按摩讓
剩餘面膜吸收。 最後用微濕棉片輕拍去除殘留物。
結束護理:最後塗抹一層多效防護霜抵禦外界環境。
護理週期 :
建議至少先進行4-5次護理(為一個療程),每週1次。
其後每15天進行1次護理(4次為一個療程) 。
最後每月進行1次維護護理。
注意:針對色斑問題,必須使用完整的美容護理流程。

用扇形刷薄薄塗抹3-5ml的Delight 3PRO第一步煥膚產品,停留5分鐘。必要時,在沖洗前用指尖輕輕按摩重點區域。
清潔/沖洗 :徹底沖洗。
平衡參數(pH值+天然保濕因子)
輕拍塗抹一層薄的特殊消失霜恢復pH值,然後用紗布輕拍特殊保濕復合物恢復天然保濕因子。
註:前4次護理必須執行此步驟,之後可由操作師酌情選擇。 僅在色斑處塗抹0.5ml Delight擊退黑斑精華,直到吸收。
控制黑色素形成階段 : 用輕刷動作在全臉塗抹5ml Delight 3PRO第二步啫哩激活劑,停留5分鐘。
昇華階段 : 用刷子塗抹10ml Delight 3PRO第三步驟護理面膜,停留7-10分鐘,期間可進行指壓按摩。時間到後,透過抗老按摩讓
剩餘面膜吸收。 最後用微濕棉片輕拍去除殘留物。
結束護理:最後塗抹一層多效防護霜抵禦外界環境。

護理週期 :
建議至少先進行4-5次護理(為一個療程),每週1次。
其後每15天進行1次護理(4次為一個療程) 。
最後每月進行1次維護護理。
注意:針對色斑問題,必須使用完整的美容護理流程。
